prose: Simon Willison's beat for llm-anthropic 0.29: same-day support for Claude Opus 5.5 in his LLM command-line tool, invoked as llm -m claude-opus-5.5. The release landed the day Opus 5.5 shipped, keeping his tooling current with Anthropic's latest model.
highlights: A Simon Willison beat (short link-blog entry)
